label: Late deterministic law changes preserve the prefix observation law and split the successor law
paraphrase: For any record cutoff n and switch date k at or after n, the copy and delayed-toggle schedules have the same exact observation law for the finite trace through n. The observation of their state at the successor of k has different laws. These are per-schedule point masses, without weights over the two schedules, and the result is conditional on that supplied pair of alternatives.
